description: Table lookup for ambient temperature; returns ambient temperature in degrees C (in variable t_amb_C) based on input value of Z_m (geometric altitude, meters) using the breakpoint values in Z_m_pts and the table defined in T_dgC_table.

description: Table lookup for pressure ratio; returns ambient pressure normalized with SL pressure (in variable p_p0) based on input value of Z_m (geometric altitude, meters) using the breakpoint values in Z_m_pts and the table defined in P_P0_table.

description: Table lookup for density ratio; returns density normalized with SL density (in variable sigma) based on input value of Z_m (geometric altitude, meters) using the breakpoint values in Z_m_pts and the table defined in sigma_table.
name: sigma_function
